title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Funding Fee Table by Program and Down-Payment Band
content:
The VA Home Loan Guaranty sets a funding fee percentage for each of its seven programs, one figure for a first use of the home loan benefit and one for a subsequent use, each a percent of the loan amount. The purchase-type programs also carry a down-payment band: the lowest down payment that places a purchase in the band (inclusive) and the down payment at which a purchase moves to the next band (exclusive), each a percent of the price.

## Schedule

| Program | First-use fee (% of loan amount) | Subsequent-use fee (% of loan amount) | Band minimum, inclusive (% of price) | Band maximum, exclusive (% of price) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| VA Interest Rate Reduction Refinance Loan (IRRRL) | 0.5 | 0.5 | 0 | 0 |
| VA Manufactured Home Loan | 1.0 | 1.0 | 5.0 | 100.0 |
| VA Purchase Loan (10% or More Down) | 1.25 | 1.25 | 10.0 | 100.0 |
| VA Purchase Loan (5% to Less Than 10% Down) | 1.5 | 1.5 | 5.0 | 10.0 |
| VA Purchase Loan (Less Than 5% Down) | 2.15 | 3.3 | 0 | 5.0 |
| VA Cash-Out Refinance Loan | 2.15 | 3.3 | 0 | 0 |
| Native American Direct Loan (NADL) | 1.25 | 1.25 | 0 | 100.0 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The first-use column applies when the loan is the veteran's first use of the home loan benefit; the subsequent-use column applies otherwise.
2. A band minimum is inclusive and a band maximum is exclusive. A down payment equal to a band's maximum therefore falls outside that band.
3. Only the VA Purchase Loan (Less Than 5% Down) and the VA Cash-Out Refinance Loan carry a subsequent-use figure different from the first-use figure; on every other program the two figures are the same.

## Reading the bands (hypothetical down payments)

| Hypothetical down payment on a purchase | VA Purchase Loan (Less Than 5% Down), 0 to 5.0 | VA Purchase Loan (5% to Less Than 10% Down), 5.0 to 10.0 | VA Purchase Loan (10% or More Down), 10.0 to 100.0 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4.99 percent | inside | outside | outside |
| 5.0 percent | outside (5.0 is the exclusive maximum) | inside (5.0 is the inclusive minimum) | outside |
| 9.99 percent | outside | inside | outside |
| 10.0 percent | outside | outside (10.0 is the exclusive maximum) | inside (10.0 is the inclusive minimum) |
